verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ יְדוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אֶל־ אֱ֭לֹהִים אַ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- yə·ḏū·ṯūn miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’aḵ nap̄·šî dū·mî·yāh yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî mim·men·nū
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Jeduthun A Psalm of David In God alone my soul finds rest my salvation comes from Him

verses.original: ה֣וּא אַךְ־ צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־ אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hū ’aḵ- ṣū·rî wî·šū·‘ā·ṯî miś·gab·bî lō- ’em·mō·wṭ rab·bāh
verses.literal: He alone is my rock and my salvation [He is] my fortress I will never be shaken . . .

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֤נָה׀ תְּהֽוֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם תְּרָצְּח֪וּ נָט֑וּי כְּקִ֥יר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃ גָּ֝דֵ֗ר
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh tə·hō·wṯ·ṯū ʿal ’îš ḵul·lə·ḵem tə·rāṣ·ṣə·ḥū nā·ṭui kə·qîr had·də·ḥū·yāh gā·ḏêr
verses.literal: How long . . . will you threaten . . . a man Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ יָעֲצ֣וּ לְהַדִּיחַ֮ מִשְּׂאֵת֨וֹ׀ יִרְצ֪וּ כָ֫זָ֥ב בְּפִ֥יו יְבָרֵ֑כוּ יְקַלְלוּ־ וּ֝בְקִרְבָּ֗ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ yā·‘ă·ṣū lə·had·dî·aḥ miś·śə·’ê·ṯōw yir·ṣū ḵā·zāḇ bə·p̄îw yə·ḇā·rê·ḵū yə·qal·lū- ū·ḇə·qir·bām se·lāh
verses.literal: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch they delight in lies with their mouths they bless but inwardly they curse . . . Selah

verses.original: דּ֣וֹמִּי לֵ֭אלֹהִים אַ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּי־ תִּקְוָתִֽי׃ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ
verses.transliteration: dō·wm·mî lê·lō·hîm ’aḵ nap̄·šî kî- tiq·wā·ṯî mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Rest in God alone O my soul for my hope comes from Him

verses.original: ה֣וּא אַךְ־ צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.literal: He alone is my rock and my salvation [He is] my fortress I will not be shaken

verses.original: יִשְׁעִ֣י וּכְבוֹדִ֑י עַל־ אֱ֭לֹהִים עֻזִּ֥י צוּר־ מַ֝חְסִ֗י בֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.literal: My salvation and my honor rest on God my strong rock my refuge is in God

verses.original: בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤וֹ בְכָל־ עֵ֨ת׀ עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם לְפָנָ֥יו אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־ לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: biṭ·ḥū ḇōw ḇə·ḵāl- ‘êṯ ‘ām šip̄·ḵū- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ĕ·lō·hîm ma·ḥă·seh- lā·nū se·lāh
verses.literal: Trust in Him at all times O people pour out your hearts before Him God is our refuge Selah

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ אָדָם֮ אַ֤ךְ׀ הֶ֥בֶל בְּנֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ כָּזָ֪ב בְּמֹאזְנַ֥יִם הֵ֝֗מָּה לַעֲל֑וֹת יָֽחַד׃ מֵהֶ֥בֶל
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ’ā·ḏām ’aḵ he·ḇel bə·nê ’îš kā·zāḇ bə·mō·zə·na·yim hêm·māh la·‘ă·lō·wṯ yā·ḥaḏ mê·he·ḇel
verses.literal: Lowborn men [are] but a vapor the exalted . . . [are] but a lie Weighed on the scale they go up together they are but a vapor

verses.original: אַל־ תִּבְטְח֣וּ בְעֹשֶׁק֮ תֶּ֫הְבָּ֥לוּ אַל־ וּבְגָזֵ֪ל כִּֽי־ חַ֤יִל׀ יָנ֑וּב אַל־ תָּשִׁ֥יתוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ḇə·‘ō·šeq teh·bā·lū ’al- ū·ḇə·ḡā·zêl kî- ḥa·yil yā·nūḇ ’al- tā·šî·ṯū lêḇ
verses.literal: Place no trust in extortion or false hope . . . in stolen goods If your riches increase do not set your heart [upon them]

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֬ר אַחַ֤ת׀ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י ז֥וּ שְׁתַּֽיִם־ עֹ֝֗ז לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm dib·ber ’a·ḥaṯ šā·mā·‘ə·tî kî zū šə·ta·yim- ‘ōz lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: God has spoken once I have heard . . . this twice that power belongs to God

verses.original: חָ֑סֶד וּלְךָֽ־ אֲדֹנָ֥י כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·seḏ ū·lə·ḵā- ’ă·ḏō·nāy kî- ’at·tāh ṯə·šal·lêm lə·’îš kə·ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: and loving devotion to You O Lord For You will repay each man according to his deeds
